output_list.criticism: The mintToken function allows setting the balance of an arbitrary user to any value, which is a valid overflow vulnerability.
The buy function has an overflow where the amount of tokens to be bought is determined by the value of the pay variable.
The sell function has an overflow where the amount of tokens to be sold is determined by the amount of tokens in the balance of this contract.
The transfer function has an overflow where the amount of tokens to be transferred is determined by the amount of tokens in the balance of this contract.
